topography.project_purpose: Cross Chain Bridge. Structurally: 138 project-authored contract(s) across 6 chain(s); 19 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 32 common project-authored base contract(s) (oapp, oappsender, oappcore). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
